name: planning_analysis_path
description: First planning turns of a V3 task (new thread, no pending slots). Used by magician-bin/examples/planning_analysis_path_eval.rs to compare the legacy and new planning analysis paths (planning-decisions Phase C steps 3-4). `expect_clarification` is the reviewer's reading of whether a careful assistant must ask before planning; it is context, not the parity reference (legacy is).
